title: Lenten Exhibition
deck: An exhibition open in the church through the closing weeks of Lent — a space to pause, look and reflect.
body:
Through the closing weeks of Lent, an exhibition is open within the church — a quiet space to pause, look and reflect as Holy Week draws near.

The exhibition is open from Passion Sunday until Good Friday. All are welcome to visit during the church's opening hours; do ask a member of the clergy if you would like to know more.
